content: Go net/http: http.DefaultTransport uses ProxyFromEnvironment automatically (HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY/NO_PROXY; values cached at first use; loopback never proxied). IPv6: Go resolver sorts per RFC 6724 so IPv6 preferred; Happy Eyeballs FallbackDelay 300ms mitigates broken IPv6 but requests can still stall up to the delay per dial; unlike Node, there is no setDefaultResultOrder equivalent needed but dialer tuning (DualStack/FallbackDelay) and NO_PROXY exclusions are the Go-side equivalents of the Node fetch IPv6-first and dead-proxy pitfalls.
